decisions.reason: The illustrated series is a multi-model line with substantial sunk design and production effort and a visible public commitment that fits the curated-edition strategy, so management will keep investing in it and treat slow sales as the time a series needs to build up.
The jazz vinyl reissue had its own page and fits the announced push into new genres and formats, so it justifies the earlier decision and is likely to remain in the catalog even if sales are modest.
A multi-disc box set represents a large sunk investment in licensing, mastering and packaging and is prominently presented, so management will keep selling down the stock rather than write it off.

The compilation CD was only mentioned on the site and carries little investment or public commitment, much like the withdrawn Product A, so dropping it is quite possible, but low carrying costs in a warehouse-backed catalog favour keeping it for now.
